subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear [Applicant Name], Thank you for submitting your application for the [Job Title] position at our company. We have carefully reviewed your qualifications and experience, and we are impressed with your background. We would like to invite you for an interview to discuss further details about the role. Please let us know your availability for next week so we can schedule a meeting. We look forward to meeting you in person. Best regards, [Hiring Manager]
